semanticConstraints: ClientSecret must be empty for the public SPA-PKCE profile; a configured secret is rejected and no secret values are emitted.
AllowedOrigins must contain at least one exact absolute origin with root path and no wildcard, query or fragment.
The supported SPA-PKCE structural schema complements this publisher-owned profile contract; it does not replace common authentication validation.
Export never creates a WebApplication, initializes bearer handlers or contacts discovery/identity services.
